annotations.provider: A local stand-in, crates/test-provider, for a provider that signs its own transactions, such as Plume's nOPAL mint. Its share mint is nOPAL's, for the display only.

message: request that the test provider mint {outputs.shareMint} for {inputs.amount} of {inputs.asset} from {inputs.owner}

postConditions.message: only System and token instructions run
the provider's wallet {accounts.wallet} receives at least {inputs.amount} of {inputs.asset}
